claims_not_made: no derivation of the wall premise or of P1/P2 consequences
finite graphs (4-ring) do not establish a general TFPT dynamics

leak_theorem.cubic_torus_formula: 6 N b^2 = N/96 for N sites (N_dir = 6N)

dressed_code.note: first-order source dressing by H itself; the residual leak is dominated by the LL hop (coefficient a) of the hole created by the LH admixture, i.e. by mobile dressed excitations; still extensive in volume

rotor_layer.conjugation_law: Ad_{exp(-it kE^2/2)}(L) = L * f_t(E), f_t(E) = exp(-itk(2E delta(E)+delta(E)^2)/2)
rotor_layer.carry: C = U^4 P_0 + (I-P_0), U = C L exactly; C and L are two-term shift/diagonal operators (finite normal form)
rotor_layer.closed_algebra: W*(L, l^inf(E)) = l^inf(Z; M_4) (bounded product of the q-blocks, not the c_0 sum); adding U: commutant scalar, von Neumann closure B(l^2(Z)); the NORM closure of finite sums sum_k U^k g_k(E) has finite bandwidth and does not contain S_m (m>1)

coverings.energy_scaling: degree-m covering multiplies the electric energy kappa E^2/2 by m^2

gibbs_residues.unit_averaging_repair: mu_beta = int_{Z-hat^x} u_* nu_beta du (Haar average over profinite units); same divisibility moments, unit-invariant
gibbs_residues.total_variation_remark: d_TV(nu_beta, Haar) = 1 for every beta>1 and sup_m d_TV(nu_beta mod m, Unif_m) = 1; convergence is per fixed modulus / weak*, never uniform in the modulus
gibbs_residues.identification: zeta-Gibbs and the report family mu_s share the divisibility moments Pr(n|X)=n^{-beta}; they are DIFFERENT residue laws at finite beta (mu_s is unit-invariant, zeta-Gibbs is not); both tend to Haar on Z-hat (equal-weight Z4 state) as beta->1+
gibbs_residues.H_log_vs_H_E: on the loop sector H_E = (kappa/2) exp(2 H_log) on |E|>0: same eigenbasis, incompatible Gibbs states

modular_covering.identification: U_a is a separately constructed permutation of the Z_N clock with the same multiplicative composition law as the coverings S_a; the label map |n> -> |n mod N> is NOT a bounded Hilbert-space transfer l^2(Z) -> C^N (norm amplification ~ sqrt(K) on K states of one class), so 'reduction' is index reduction, not a physical isometry
modular_covering.operation_classes: three distinct cases: carry C (finite normal form, shifts 0 and 4), finite U_a (in the shift/diagonal algebra of C^N with N/gcd(a-1,N) shift labels), unbounded coverings S_m (m>1; outside every finite normal form and outside the norm closure)
modular_covering.cost_note: the number of shift labels is a complexity of this representation format, not a gate lower bound; a single U_a is distinct from the controlled exponentiation |j>|1> -> |j>|a^j mod N> (O(log N) controlled power multiplications plus their bit/gate/Fourier costs); no speedup is claimed and none is excluded by this bookkeeping
